cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. At the house meeting, back me up about the bins being Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Only on the old rota. Remember the new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having it now. Try to remember it confidently.

mechanism: A recruits B support for A preferred bin-duty assignment by correcting rota interpretation as the only competent organiser.
confusable: D29 seeks B to do the duty; this A needs B to endorse A version to another person at a meeting.
comparison: Shift alternative seeks nonverbal backing after refusal to lie; bin alternative recruits a specific procedural argument.
seedUse: House meeting, Alex and old rota derive from D31-a; S03 adds responsibility-versus-recollection distinctions instead of fabricating shared memory alone.
